comparison.objective: Accordion-fold a four-panel hinged wing into a square stack on a stowage plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential bimanual folding through alternating hinge directions.
comparison.success_condition: Panels lie flat and square over one another after release.
comparison.reason: Articulated-panel folding tests hinge sequencing, not tool engagement, collar adjustment, torque-limited locking, or impact-response commissioning.
